why:
Alt text for images the approved design ships with none.

Derived ONLY for award and certificate badges, the one filename family on this site that genuinely names its subject: 'World-Luxury-Spa-Awards-2024-300x300.png' IS the award, so the derivation is a fact, not a guess. Curated by hand where a filename cannot describe the image - written from the image itself or from the caption printed beside it on the page.

Everything else is deliberately left alone. Machine-reading the other filenames produces 'Video', 'Doc cons', 'Eye2', 'AHV About 698image' - text that would be read aloud to a screen-reader user and indexed by Google, and worse than the empty alt it replaces. Those images are listed in image-alt-unresolved.json for a person to look at.

Ornament (leaves, borders, corner flowers, the lotus mark) keeps empty alt, which is the correct value for decoration - see image-alt-decorative.json. 2026-09-19: extended with descriptions written after OPENING each image - 404 of them, fanned out across 23 agents, each instructed to read the picture and describe what is in it, transcribe any text it contains, keep the hospital register, and mark pure ornament decorative rather than invent words for it.
